code: # Download and access full postal code database for Portugal db <- MobilityDataPT::postal_code_database(cntr_id = "PT", year = 2024, crs = 4326) db |>   dplyr::select(POSTCODE, LAU_NAME, Shape) |>   dplyr::sample_n(5) #> Simple feature collection with 5 features and 2 fields #> Geometry type: POINT #> Dimension:     XY #> Bounding box:  xmin: -9.097305 ymin: 38.62705 xmax: -8.624415 ymax: 41.70859 #> Geodetic CRS:  WGS 84 #>   POSTCODE #> 1 3800-376 #> 2 4900-861 #> 3 4450-770 #> 4 2695-725 #> 5 2835-530 #>                                                                              LAU_NAME #> 1                                                                            Esgueira #> 2 União das freguesias de Viana do Castelo (Santa Maria Maior e Monserrate) e Meadela #> 3                               União das freguesias de Matosinhos e Leça da Palmeira #> 4           União das freguesias de Santa Iria de Azoia, São João da Talha e Bobadela #> 5                                                           Santo António da Charneca #>                        Shape #> 1 POINT (-8.624415 40.66091) #> 2 POINT (-8.807337 41.70859) #> 3 POINT (-8.701731 41.19593) #> 4 POINT (-9.097305 38.82328) #> 5 POINT (-9.013116 38.62705)  # Get spatial coordinates for specific postal codes coords <- MobilityDataPT::get_postal_code_coordinates(c("1000-001", "2800-001")) coords #> Simple feature collection with 2 features and 1 field #> Geometry type: POINT #> Dimension:     XY #> Bounding box:  xmin: -9.160344 ymin: 38.68097 xmax: -9.13881 ymax: 38.73317 #> Geodetic CRS:  WGS 84 #>        POSTCODE                      Shape #> 663558 2800-001 POINT (-9.160344 38.68097) #> 675430 1000-001  POINT (-9.13881 38.73317)

title: Get Started
text: Calculate expected toll costs across vehicle classes (C1, C2, C3, C4) spatial route itineraries using Infraestruturas de Portugal API service:
code: sf_itinerary <- sf::st_read(system.file("extdata/samples",   "tool_itinerary_25AbrilBridge.gpkg",   package = "MobilityDataPT" ), quiet = TRUE)  # Calculate toll costs tolls <- MobilityDataPT::tools_for_itinerary(sf_itinerary) tolls #> $C1 #> [1] 2.25 #>  #> $C2 #> [1] 4.85 #>  #> $C3 #> [1] 6.55 #>  #> $C4 #> [1] 8.45

title: Get Postal Code coordinates — get_postal_code_coordinates
text: Retrieves spatial coordinates geometry specific postal code(s) Eurostat GISCO postal code database.

title: Get Postal Code coordinates — get_postal_code_coordinates
code: get_postal_code_coordinates(   postal_codes = NULL,   cntr_id = "PT",   year = 2024,   crs = 4326,   download_dir = NULL )

title: Get Postal Code coordinates — get_postal_code_coordinates
text: postal_codes Character vector postal code identifiers (e.g., "1000-001" c("1000-001", "2800-001")). NULL, returns coordinates postal codes dataset. cntr_id Two-letter country code filter (default "PT"). Pass NA NULL return countries. year Release year dataset. Allowed values 2020 2024 (default 2024). crs Coordinate Reference System (EPSG code) dataset. Allowed values 3857, 3035, 4326 (default 4326). download_dir Directory downloaded GeoPackage files stored. Defaults MOBILITYDATAPT_DOWNLOAD_DIRECTORY environment variable ~/.local/share/R/MobilityDataPT.

title: Access Eurostat GISCO Postal Code database — postal_code_database
text: Downloads reads GISCO Postal Codes dataset provided Eurostat. Files cached locally directory specified MOBILITYDATAPT_DOWNLOAD_DIRECTORY environment variable, defaulting ~/.local/share/R/MobilityDataPT.

title: Access Eurostat GISCO Postal Code database — postal_code_database
code: postal_code_database(   cntr_id = "PT",   year = 2024,   crs = 4326,   download_dir = NULL )

title: Access Eurostat GISCO Postal Code database — postal_code_database
text: cntr_id Two-letter country code filter (default "PT"). Pass NA NULL return countries present dataset. year Release year dataset. Allowed values 2020 2024 (default 2024). crs Coordinate Reference System (EPSG code) dataset. Allowed values 3857, 3035, 4326 (default 4326). download_dir Directory downloaded GeoPackage files stored. Defaults MOBILITYDATAPT_DOWNLOAD_DIRECTORY environment variable ~/.local/share/R/MobilityDataPT.

title: Access Eurostat GISCO Postal Code database — postal_code_database
text: sf object containing spatial postal code boundaries/points. Returned columns include: POSTCODE: Postal code identifier (e.g. "1000-001") CNTR_ID: Country identifier (e.g. "PT") LAU_NAME: Local Administrative Unit name ("freguesia" Portugal) NUTS3_2024: NUTS level 3 region code Shape: Point postal code location.

title: Access Eurostat GISCO Postal Code database — postal_code_database
text: Data source: Eurostat GISCO Postal Codes (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/gisco/geodata/administrative-units/postal-codes).
